item.text: {"decision":"reject","summary":"sum.js has a correctness bug: average() returns NaN for any non-empty input because the loop reads one element past the end of the array.","issues":["sum.js:4 uses `i <= nums.length`, so the final iteration reads `nums[nums.length]` as `undefined`; adding it makes `total` become `NaN`. Use `i < nums.length` instead."]}
